body: This removes `lodash/mergeWith` usage and introduces a custom `deepMerge` util. It also simplifies the logic of the `enhanceConfiguration` function.

@samouss I first broke the implementation to check the tests fail – this function is covered in our tests. It's used to merge all widgets' search parameters. It seems like it's working as expected both in our tests and in our stories. The only bottleneck that I could see is a lower performance compared to the implementation with Lodash but I'd argue this is meaningless.

title: refactor(lodash): remove mergeWith usage
